question: Lipidator is a nonionic surfactant that is used to disrupt the lipid membranes of cells. This disruption of the lipid membrane results in the release of all of its cytoplasmic contents. Which of the following viruses would not be disrupted if treated with this detergent?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "release of cytoplasmic contents" -> "enveloped virus disrupted" -> "Herpesvirus disrupted" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "release of cytoplasmic contents" -> "enveloped virus disrupted" -> "Hepadnavirus disrupted" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "release of cytoplasmic contents" -> "enveloped virus disrupted" -> "Flavivirus disrupted" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "release of cytoplasmic contents" -> "non-enveloped virus not disrupted" -> "Picornavirus not disrupted" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "release of cytoplasmic contents" -> "enveloped virus disrupted" -> "HIV disrupted" -> 90%
analysis: Lipidator, as a nonionic surfactant, disrupts lipid membranes. Enveloped viruses, which have lipid membranes, would be disrupted by such a detergent. Herpesvirus, Hepadnavirus, Flavivirus, and HIV are all enveloped viruses, meaning they have lipid membranes that would be disrupted by Lipidator. Picornavirus, on the other hand, is a non-enveloped virus, meaning it lacks a lipid membrane and would not be disrupted by Lipidator.
